title: Interest-Free Payment Plans on Wound Care Supply Program Balances
content:
# Interest-free payment plans — Wound Care Supply Program

Financial counselling training note on payment plans for balances on the Wound Care Supply Program.

## The rule

A payment plan is offered only on tiers where the longest plan is greater than 0 months, for a balance of at least the tier's smallest balance for a plan, in no more than the tier's longest plan in monthly installments of at least the tier's smallest monthly installment; it is created as a payment plan request the customer accepts, and while an approved plan's installments are current the balance it covers is left out of the past-due test.

## Questions answered

**Is a plan offered on every tier?**
No. A plan is offered only where the tier's longest plan is greater than 0 months; a tier showing 0 months offers no payment plans.

**What must the plan's terms meet?**
Three limits together: the balance is at least the tier's smallest balance for a plan, the number of monthly installments is no more than the tier's longest plan, and each monthly installment is at least the tier's smallest monthly installment.

**Who accepts the plan?**
The plan is created as a payment plan request, and it is the customer who accepts it.

**What does an approved plan do to the past-due test?**
While the approved plan's installments are current, the balance it covers is left out of the past-due test.

## Worked cases (hypothetical balances)

| Tier and its limits | Balance | Proposed plan | Meets the limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial HMO: at least USD 150.00, up to 6 months, installments of at least USD 25.00 | USD 240.00 | 6 installments of USD 40.00 | Yes |
| Commercial HMO, same limits | USD 150.00 | 6 installments of USD 25.00 | Yes — both limits met exactly |
| Commercial HMO, same limits | USD 120.00 | any | No — below USD 150.00 |
| Medicare Advantage: at least USD 100.00, up to 10 months, installments of at least USD 20.00 | USD 100.00 | 10 installments of USD 10.00 | No — installment below USD 20.00 |
| Medicare Advantage, same limits | USD 100.00 | 5 installments of USD 20.00 | Yes |
| Medicaid: longest plan 0 months | USD 300.00 | any | No — no plans on the tier |
